popularization.ref: Cheaper moulded buckles reach the general population in the 15th century
popularization.ref_zh: 15 世纪模铸技术让普通人也能用上带扣

notes: 来源较弱：带扣在古罗马时期已有使用，但没有可靠的具体年份，因此发明年留空，只记录 15 世纪的普及。
summary_zh: 带扣在中世纪多为装饰，只属于富人；15 世纪模铸工艺让廉价带扣进入普通人的衣着。
summary_en: Medieval buckles were mostly ornamental and for the wealthy; in the 15th century moulded buckles became cheap enough for everyone.

image.alt_en: Two leather belts with metal buckles

notes_en: Weak sourcing: buckles were used in Roman times, but no reliable date exists, so invention is left null and only the 15th-century spread is recorded.
